description: This Java class, AllGroupTypesDataMapper, implements the RowMapper interface to map rows of a SQL ResultSet to GroupGeneralData objects. It constructs a SQL schema string in the constructor and uses it in the mapRow method to extract data about group entities such as IDs, names, status, dates, and associated user and office information. The class serves as a component for data retrieval and object mapping within the group service layer of the application.

classes.name: AllGroupTypesDataMapper
classes.description: Implements RowMapper to map SQL ResultSet rows to GroupGeneralData objects, constructing SQL select schema in constructor.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the SQL schema string used in constructing the query.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a row from the ResultSet to a GroupGeneralData object, extracting various group-related fields and associated metadata.
